headline: Committee discusses Bill 77 on Affordable Housing Fund and houseless residents, recesses

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meeting.summary: The committee heard public testimony and questions on Bill 77, which would require part of the Affordable Housing Fund to go toward housing for houseless people. It recessed with a second round of member questions still to come; no vote was reported.
meeting.recap: The only item was Bill 77, about the Affordable Housing Fund and houseless residents.[[0:07:06]] The bill would require part of the fund to go toward housing for people who are houseless.[[0:07:35]] The committee chair said HUD changed its homeless funding program as of June 1.[[0:08:32]] A testifier said they have never met anyone who does not want safety or shelter.[[0:23:36]] A testifier living in affordable housing said they were told to pay $85 a month for parking they say should be free.[[0:34:29]] Another testifier strongly supported Bill 77.[[0:45:47]] The director said early data shows the most need is in Central Maui.[[1:04:05]] The director said the department must plan with the Department of Human Concerns before seeking building designs.[[1:04:51]] A council member said they support the change to county law but not spending money until there is a design.[[1:09:46]] The director said the department will focus on houselessness whether or not the bill passes.[[1:28:13]]
decided: Members agreed to take public testimony after opening comments.
meeting.next: The committee recessed with a second round of member questions still to come.

moments.q: "I've never once met anyone who doesn't want to get into safety or shelter."
Director: bill "could be interpreted as redundant"
"I'm not ready to vote on something like this."

issues.next: The committee recessed with a second round of member questions still to come.
issues.brief: A council member said they see vacancies at existing shelters.[[#1]] The director said the department has a list of county properties it is targeting for development.[[#2]]
